name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd
about: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL), a part of the Mahindra Group,is a NBFC primarily engaged in the business of financing purchase of new and pre-owned auto and utility vehicles, tractors, cars, commercial vehicles, construction equipment and SME Financing. [1]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 37.2%
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
